svg.title: Keyboard modes and explicit lifecycle actions
svg.desc: Ordinary modes and masking preserve already-running work. Devices refuses busy audio or answers and otherwise closes Q A for setup. Start, Stop, Cancel and Clear are separate explicit actions.
